# PDF.js for OCR source review

Pinned to the latest stable official release verified on 27 October 2026: [PDF.js 6.4.299](https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/releases/tag/v6.4.299), published 3 October 2026. Source: [pdfjs-6.4.299-dist.zip](https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/releases/download/v6.4.299/pdfjs-6.4.299-dist.zip). The downloaded archive matches the release's SHA-256: `f2245eb7ef3f674c872fe568a177bfec15874f5c034613e55d8e307f93ebd86d`. `SHA256SUMS` records every vendored upstream file. Upstream files are unmodified.

Included: `build/pdf.mjs`, `build/pdf.worker.mjs` (placed here), all `web/cmaps` and `web/standard_fonts`, the JBIG2 and JPEG2000 WASM image decoders, and their license notices. `assets.rs` declares the 184 binary rendering resources to Topcoat. The OCR result passes their content-hashed URLs to PDF.js's `BinaryDataFactory` with `useWorkerFetch: false`. The library and worker are also declared with `asset!`; Topcoat 0.10's MIME detection serves `.mjs` as `application/javascript`. No CDN, browser build step or remote preview service is used. Resources load only as needed, not when their URLs are rendered.

The full upstream viewer, scripting/sandbox/QuickJS support, source maps, locale bundles, and JavaScript image-decoder fallbacks are omitted: this app renders page canvases only and supports browsers with WebAssembly. ICC/qcms resources are omitted; PDF.js uses its built-in colour conversion, so this is a reading preview rather than a colour-proofing view. Embedded fonts (including the Arabic fixture) and the supplied standard fonts and character maps cover document text without depending on system fonts. A PDF requiring an unavailable decoder or unsupported feature may fail locally; recognized text, copying and downloads remain available with a source-reselection action.

To update: verify the current stable release and archive checksum on the official release page, replace the included files and notices, regenerate `SHA256SUMS` and `assets.rs`, then run the OCR review tests in Chromium and WebKit plus the bundled-asset checks. Do not copy a different worker version beside the library.
